description: This file implements the logic for delivering subagent announcements, including queuing, direct delivery, retries, error handling, and session context resolution within a messaging system.

methods.name: resolveDirectAnnounceTransientRetryDelaysMs
methods.description: Determines retry delays based on environment variable for testing speed or default values.

methods.name: resolveSubagentAnnounceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Calculates the timeout for subagent announcement based on configuration, with a default fallback.

methods.name: isInternalAnnounceRequesterSession
methods.description: Checks if a session key indicates an internal subagent request or cron session.

methods.name: summarizeDeliveryError
methods.description: Converts an error object into a string message for logging and error handling.

methods.name: shouldStripThreadFromAnnounceEntry
methods.description: Determines if thread information should be stripped from an announcement based on plugin rules.

methods.name: isTransientAnnounceDeliveryError
methods.description: Checks if an error matches transient error patterns, indicating a retryable failure.

methods.name: waitForAnnounceRetryDelay
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for a specified delay, supporting abort signals.

methods.name: runAnnounceDeliveryWithRetry
methods.description: Retries an async operation for delivery, with exponential delays on transient errors.

methods.name: resolveAnnounceOrigin
methods.description: Resolves the origin context for an announcement, merging requester and session info.

methods.name: resolveSubagentCompletionOrigin
methods.description: Resolves the delivery context for subagent completion, including hook-based overrides.

methods.name: sendAnnounce
methods.description: Sends an announcement message via the gateway, respecting timeout and session context.

methods.name: resolveRequesterStoreKey
methods.description: Generates a normalized session key for requester sessions based on configuration.

methods.name: loadRequesterSessionEntry
methods.description: Loads session entry data for a requester session key.

methods.name: loadSessionEntryByKey
methods.description: Loads session data directly by session key.

methods.name: buildAnnounceQueueKey
methods.description: Creates a queue key for announcements, optionally including account ID.

methods.name: maybeQueueSubagentAnnounce
methods.description: Decides whether to queue or drop an announcement based on session state and queue mode.

methods.name: sendSubagentAnnounceDirectly
methods.description: Performs direct delivery of a subagent announcement, with retry and error handling.

methods.name: deliverSubagentAnnouncement
methods.description: Main function to deliver a subagent announcement, either queued or direct, with dispatch logic.

methods.name: __testing.setDepsForTest
methods.description: Allows injection of dependencies for testing purposes.
